const Profile::MESG* Profile::GetMesg(const FIT_UINT16 num)
{
    static const std::vector<FIT_UINT16> order = []()
    {
        std::vector<FIT_UINT16> v;
        v.reserve(MESGS);
        for (int i = 0; i < MESGS; i++)

        std::stable_sort(v.begin(), v.end(), [](FIT_UINT16 a, FIT_UINT16 b)

                return mesgs[idx].num < value;
            });

    if (it != order.end() && mesgs[*it].num == num)

        return &mesgs[*it];
    }

    return NULL;
}
